purpose: Test the necessary local-maximum condition derived from Bohé et al. 1611.03703v3 Eq. (2.12) and C1 matching, changing only the native q8 ringdown free amplitude rate in a development-only counterfactual. Compare at the frozen prepeak GW-frequency anchor without fitting to the public waveform.
derived_condition: For A'(0)=0, Eq. (2.12) gives A''(0)/A(0)=-gamma*(gamma+2*c1f*tanh(c2f)). A local maximum requires gamma+2*c1f*tanh(c2f)>=0. For c2f<0, cap c1f at -gamma/(2*tanh(c2f)); retain c2f and all other inputs.
